Piece Counter uses the camera (or a photo you pick from your gallery) only to detect and count puzzle pieces. The photos are analyzed directly on your device by a built-in TensorFlow Lite model and are never sent to servers, cloud services or third parties. A photo is kept on your device only while you look at its analysis and is deleted as soon as you continue, retake it or close the check; only the counts of each check are kept in the history.

The TensorFlow Lite runtime that runs the model is provided by Google Play services. It may download updates from Google and sends Google technical diagnostics and usage data about itself (for example the device model, the Android and app version, a device identifier, errors and speed), as described in Google\'s privacy policy – but never your photos.
